projects.title: AI-Driven CRM Build -- 2
projects.full_description:
I plan to bring a ready-to-use, AI-integrated CRM to market that multiple businesses can subscribe to immediately. The first release must serve real estate companies, service-based businesses (repair, beauty, cleaning, etc.) and sales or marketing agencies without custom code for each client.

Core objective 
The standout feature of version 1 is AI voice calling with automatic lead qualification. Incoming or scheduled calls should be placed through an integrated telephony API (Twilio, Plivo, Asterisk or similar), transcribed in real time and analysed by an AI layer that scores interest level, tags intent and schedules the next action automatically. This mechanism has to plug seamlessly into the broader lead-capture workflow so teams can see conversation history, call recordings and follow-up status from a single dashboard.

Platform scope 
Alongside the voice AI, the application must already include the essentials expected in a modern CRM: centralised lead and customer records, deal pipelines, automated follow-ups, booking and payment logging, employee attendance and salary tracking, plus visual sales and performance reports. All modules must be configurable so different industries can enable or hide features, rename stages and adapt notifications without developer intervention.

Technical considerations 
• Multi-tenant architecture so each company has isolated data. 
• Responsive web interface (React, Vue or similar) backed by a modular API (Node.js, Laravel, Django, etc.). 
• Flexible workflow engine or rule builder for no-code automation tweaks. 
• Role-based access, audit logs and GDPR-ready data export. 

Deliverables for this project 
1. MVP SaaS platform deployed to a cloud environment (AWS, GCP or Azure) with CI/CD. 
2. AI voice call and lead-qualification engine connected to the telephony provider of choice, with scoring logic documented. 
3. Core CRM modules (lead pipeline, follow-ups, bookings, payments, team management, reporting) in production-ready state. 
4. Admin panel to manage plans, enable/disable modules per client and set one-time purchase pricing tiers. 
5. Installation, source code, unit tests and setup documentation that allow my team to extend the product after launch. 

Acceptance criteria 
• A new company can sign up, complete onboarding and make the first AI-assisted call without developer help. 
• Lead score, intent tags and recommended next action appear in the contact record within seconds of call completion. 
• Permissions, data and custom labels stay isolated between tenants. 
• System sustains at least 100 concurrent users with sub-second UI response under standard load tests. 

A live demo environment and clear milestone hand-offs will keep the build transparent. Once this foundation is solid, I’ll commission follow-up work for advanced analytics, mobile apps and marketplace integrations.

projects.full_description:
**CONTEST TITLE: Design an Exceptional High-Fashion Brochure for VOXA House**

We are seeking an exceptional editorial designer to create a **commercial-grade, luxury brochure** for VOXA House—a curated ecosystem supporting creators, models, and creative professionals.

This brochure should feel like **a personal invitation into an exclusive creative world**. It must have the sophistication, photography, typography, and visual storytelling of a high-fashion magazine.

**Exceptional quality is essential. All photography must be real. AI-generated imagery is not permitted.**

**THE OBJECTIVE**

Introduce prospective members to VOXA House, communicate the benefits of our services, and encourage them to begin the introduction and onboarding process.

The reader should understand:

- What VOXA House offers and why the ecosystem matters.
- How PULSE supports their content, productivity, and wellbeing.
- How Media Day helps them create luxury content and build connections.
- How these experiences support a stronger personal brand.
- What to do next.

**FORMAT**

- Finished page size: **9 inches wide × 6 inches high**, landscape.
- Full interior spread: **18 inches wide × 6 inches high**.
- Total: **16 pages**, including front and back covers.
- Structure: front cover, seven interior spreads, and back cover.

Our reference draft includes designer’s notes extending to the right of each spread. **Those panels are instructions only and must not appear in the finished brochure.**

**CREATIVE DIRECTION**

The entire brochure must have a **high-fashion magazine aesthetic and feel**.

We want dramatic real photography, confident editorial compositions, oversized serif typography, refined supporting type, generous negative space, and concise copy.

Preferred palette: deep burgundy, black, ivory, cream, and restrained metallic accents.

Each spread should feel individually art-directed while belonging to one cohesive publication. Vary the layouts, image scale, and pacing. Create an engaging progression from the cover through the final invitation.

Luxury should come through the quality of the design and photography.

**CONTENT AND SPREAD REQUIREMENTS**

**Front cover — The invitation**

Create a dramatic, memorable fashion cover. Establish VOXA House immediately and make the reader feel invited into something distinctive.

Suggested direction: **“You’re invited.”**

**Spread 1 — Introducing VOXA House**

Dedicate this spread to VOXA House: our purpose, goals, and what we can do for creators.

Introduce the connected ecosystem of content production, personal brand development, practical support, and meaningful relationships.

**Spread 2 — PULSE**

Create a full commercial advertisement for PULSE as a service.

Highlight:

- Social media management and content planning.
- Health, wellness, and healthy routines.
- Daily productivity and time management.
- Technology, organization, and habit development.
- The team providing personal support behind the tools.

PULSE is both **a suite of tools and a support team** helping creators navigate their day-to-day challenges. Any depiction of planned technology should be identified appropriately.

**Spread 3 — Media Day**

Create a full commercial advertisement for our luxury content production experience.

Media Day brings together a curated number of creators **once or twice a month**, shooting content at different locations.

Highlight editorial photography, short-form video, creative direction, styling, collaboration, and purposeful networking.

**Spread 4 — Building Your Personal Brand**

Show how creators can develop a distinctive, cohesive presence through positioning, storytelling, aesthetic development, content direction, and portfolio refinement.

Communicate the value of a recognizable identity and stronger professional presentation.

**Spread 5 — The VOXA House Ecosystem**

Explain how everything connects and why the ecosystem matters.

Make **access** a central theme: access to people, creative resources, collaborative environments, professional relationships, and relevant opportunities.

Pair the luxury positioning with a clear sense of community and practical value.

**Spread 6 — The Journey Inside**

Present the member experience clearly:

Discover → Define → Prepare → Create → Review and Release → Reflect and Refine.

Show an ongoing relationship supported by communication, preparation, feedback, and consistency.

**Spread 7 — Your Next Steps**

Explain how to begin: introduce yourself, share goals and profiles, discuss fit, review participation options, and start onboarding.

Keep the tone personal, welcoming, and selective.

**Back cover — The final invitation**

Close with a strong brand impression, concise call to action, website, and a clearly scannable QR code.

Current QR destination: **[login to view URL]**.

**PHOTOGRAPHY REQUIREMENTS**

- **Real photography only. No AI-generated images, people, backgrounds, or scenes.**
- Use professionally photographed fashion, editorial, lifestyle, wellness, and authentic collaboration imagery.
- Select images with cohesive lighting, styling, color, and mood.
- Original photography or appropriately licensed stock is acceptable.
- Identify image sources and any licensing costs with your submission.
- Final images must be cleared for the intended commercial print and digital use.
- Final delivery must contain high-resolution images without watermarks or placeholders.

**CONTEST SUBMISSION**

For initial judging, submit:

1. Front cover.
2. Complete VOXA House introduction spread.
3. Complete PULSE spread.
4. Complete Media Day spread.

Show the spreads flat so we can assess the actual design. Presentation mockups may be included as supplementary images.

The selected designer will complete the full 16-page brochure and incorporate feedback.

**FINAL DELIVERABLES**

- Complete 16-page brochure.
- Print-ready PDF with printer-approved bleed, color settings, and image resolution.
- Digital PDF presented as full spreads.
- Separate-page PDF for printing.
- Fully editable source files, preferably Adobe InDesign.
- Packaged linked images and font information, subject to licensing.
- Image source and licensing documentation.
- Tested back-cover QR code.

**HOW WE WILL SELECT THE WINNER**

We will evaluate high-fashion editorial quality, photography selection, typography, composition, commercial clarity, brand consistency, and attention to detail.

The supplied draft establishes the content and intent. We expect the winning designer to elevate it into an **exceptional, professionally finished publication that feels worthy of the VOXA House brand**.

• Market opens → strategy checks the chosen trend indicators on the underlying (index or stock that I can select). 
• If bullish, it sells an ATM/OTM put and buys a farther OTM put as the hedge. 
• If bearish, it sells an ATM/OTM call and buys a farther OTM call as the hedge. 
• All lot sizes, strike distances, indicator periods, entry time-window, stop-loss, and profit-target percentages must be inputs I can tweak. 

Deliverables I need from you: 
1. A fully deployable Tradetron strategy link in my account with the above logic, including entry, exit, hedge, and position-sizing modules. 
2. Brief documentation (one-pager is fine) explaining each user variable so I can adjust it without touching the underlying code. 
3. One live dry-run session (screen sharing or recording) that proves orders are generated exactly as specified.
4. Backtesting for a year in tradetron or any othet platform

Acceptance criteria: the strategy should complete a paper-trading day in my Tradetron account without errors, generating the correct hedge leg for every short position and flipping between call and put sides strictly according to the chosen indicator signal.

If you already have experience coding on Tradetron for NSE derivatives and can knock this out quickly, let’s get started.
